subject: executor: reuse chunk in hash join v2 during restoring (#56936)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff (vs first parent) around HashJoinV2 spill/restore. The change reuses per-worker restore chunks via `DataInDiskByChunks.FillChunk`, and adds a guard in `baseJoinProbe.SetRestoredChunkForProbe` to prevent overwriting an in-use chunk (including the all-partitions-spilled skip-probe path). The restored data is consumed synchronously and copied into row tables/output chunks, and restore buffers are per-worker (no shared `DataInDiskByChunks`/chunk reuse across goroutines). No Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, concurrency, or session/transaction behavior issues found in the touched executor paths.
